messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — proposing a short 'remediation escrow' handbook for follow-ups. Goal: make ownership explicit across IC rotations and surface recurring patterns faster. Pilot infra-only for 3 weeks.

mona: +1. Can we include a tiny timeline template per action so expectations are clear? I propose: Detect (0h) -> Triage (<=2h) -> Hotfix (P0: <=72h / P1: <=7d / P2: <=21d) -> Verify (24h observation) -> Close (with artifact).

yvonne: Love the timeline. Add a comms cadence section: when escrow created post 1-line to #eng-oncall and service channel: "Action <id> — owner — ETA — blocker". Then automated 72h status pings until verification artifact attached.

raj: For IC rotation: add an "IC swap checklist" item: 1) read open escrows >48h, 2) mark IC-observer on each card you pick up, 3) confirm verify-step is defined. That'll reduce lost items across shifts.

alex: Proposed escrow card fields (minimal): owner, fallback, priority, escrow_expiry, verify_artifact, recurrence_key, blockers, handoff_note, ic_observer. Sample expiry rules: P0=72h, P1=7d, P2=21d.

yvonne: Recurrence detection: tracker should compute recurrence_key from service + error fingerprint. If key appears 3x in 60d, auto-open a recurrence-review epic and attach the last 3 postmortems. This epic gets a 2-week SLA and product+infra are looped in.

mona: Verification must be required for closing. Acceptable artifacts: dashboard snapshot link, smoke-run link, or a canary PR. No artifact -> bot reopens escrow. Keeps ownership honest.

ops-bot: [reminder] Escrow 2301112222-5 (owner: @mona) due in 24h — pinging fallback @raj.

raj: Metrics for pilot success: median time-to-close, % actions closed with verification, # recurrence-epics created, and number of escrows that moved owner due to expiry. Track these weekly.

yvonne: I'll add the IC swap checklist to the oncall rotation doc and include a one-line 'review escrows' step at the top of the handoff.

alex: Next steps: (1) mona creates pilot board + card schema + README by Fri, (2) raj wires recurrence-keyer + escalation rule by Tue, (3) yvonne updates oncall playbook with IC-swap checklist by Mon, (4) alex configures bot announcements and weekly digest by Tue. Quick 20-min demo mid-pilot. Please post one-line updates in this thread during pilot: "Action <id> — owner — status".

mona: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/remediation-handbook/pull/1 — includes card schema and sample timeline. Feedback welcome.

raj: Draft recurrence rule: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/compare/recur-2301 — comments invited.

yvonne: Scheduled demo invite to #eng-oncall. Let's try to make this lightweight so oncall noise stays low.

alex: Thanks everyone — aim is clearer ownership, fewer forgotten postmortems, and faster detection of recurring failures. :rocket:
